import sys, hashlib; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from harness import *
# Initial with a token, overlong token-length varint
tok = bytes(range(20))
head = b'\xc0'+b'\x00\x00\x00\x01'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x03\x01\x02\x03' + v(len(tok),4) + tok + v(1+1,2) + b'\x09' + b'\x01'
r = run1([datagram(head, auth=(0,))])
canon = b'\xc0'+b'\x00\x00\x00\x01'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x03\x01\x02\x03' + v(len(tok)) + tok + v(2) + b'\x09' + b'\x01'

bad = b'\xc0'+b'\x00\x00\x00\x01'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x01\xbb' + v(200,2) + b'\x01'
